country_profile.notes_unique: The Mozambique Channel is one of the richest marine biodiversity corridors; massive offshore natural gas discoveries are reshaping the economy; one of the few African flags featuring a modern weapon (AK-47).

natural_resources.notes: Rovuma Basin LNG reserves among world's largest ('found gas' ~180 tcf); TotalEnergies $20B LNG project (suspended due to insurgency); Cahora Bassa Dam (one of Africa's largest hydropower plants); Montepuez ruby mine (world's largest); coal exports from Tete province via Nacala Corridor.

military.notes: FADM (Armed Forces); SADC Mission in Mozambique (SAMIM) deployed 2021 to combat Cabo Delgado insurgency; Rwandan forces also deployed; limited capacity; Islamist insurgency (al-Shabaab/ASWJ) in Cabo Delgado since 2017.

infrastructure.notes: 3 corridor strategy (Maputo, Beira, Nacala); Vodacom, Tmcel; Maputo-Catembe bridge (Africa's longest suspension bridge).

debt_aid.notes: Hidden debt scandal (2016, $2B secret loans) devastated donor relations and led to IMF suspension; heavily aid-dependent; LNG revenues expected mid-2020s; Nacala transport corridor critical for coal exports.

education.notes: Portuguese language of instruction; massive post-war education expansion; low completion rates; insurgency in Cabo Delgado has closed hundreds of schools; teacher shortages severe in rural areas.

diaspora_migration.notes: Mozambican mineworkers in South Africa (historic); Cabo Delgado insurgency displaced 1 million internally; cross-border movement with Tanzania and Malawi; xenophobic violence in South Africa affects Mozambicans.
diaspora_migration.immigration_policy: Hosts refugees from DRC, Burundi; Mozambicans migrate to South Africa (mines)

digital_economy.notes: EASSy and SEACOM submarine cables; Vodacom and Tmcel primary operators; mobile money expanding especially in rural areas; e-Government platform (SISTAFE for public finance); low broadband penetration.

geography.terrain: Coastal lowlands (south and central); mountainous western border; Zambezi River valley; Mozambique Channel; coral islands (Bazaruto/Quirimbas)
geography.notes: 2,470 km coastline (longest in SE Africa); Mozambique Channel; Bazaruto/Quirimbas archipelagos; Cahora Bassa dam; Gorongosa NP restoration success.

economy_extended.notes: Massive LNG reserves (Rovuma Basin, TotalEnergies Afungi—$20B project suspended due to insurgency); aluminum (Mozal smelter); coal (Tete); hidden debt scandal (2016, $2B tuna bonds); Cabo Delgado insurgency.

health.notes: One of worst HIV burdens (12%); PEPFAR major impact; Cyclones Idai (2019) and Freddy (2023) devastated health infrastructure; tecnicos de medicina (mid-level health workers).

food_agriculture.notes: Cashew nuts (major export, reviving industry); ProSAVANA (Japan-Brazil agriculture programme, controversial); chronic food insecurity; cyclone impacts.

energy.notes: Cahora Bassa dam (2075 MW, exports to South Africa); massive Rovuma LNG reserves; gas from Temane/Pande fields; EDM utility; very low rural access.

transport.notes: 3 development corridors: Maputo, Beira, Nacala (connecting landlocked neighbors to ports); Nacala rail to Malawi.

tourism.notes: Beach/diving tourism growing; whale sharks and mantas at Tofo; Gorongosa restoration; Cabo Delgado insurgency deterring northern tourism.

human_rights_gender.notes: FRELIMO one-party dominance since independence; RENAMO conflict legacy; child marriage extremely high; decriminalized homosexuality 2015 (progressive for Africa); Cabo Delgado conflict atrocities.

security_stability.notes: Cabo Delgado insurgency (Islamic State affiliate, since 2017; 4000+ killed, 1M+ displaced); SADC/Rwanda military intervention; TotalEnergies LNG suspended; 2023 election disputes.

national_symbols: AK-47 (on flag—only national flag with a modern weapon)
cultural_heritage.national_dish: Matapa (cassava leaf stew with coconut and peanut)
notable_historical_figures: Graça Machel (activist, widow of Machel and Mandela)
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: TVM state; STV (private); Canal de Moçambique; limited press freedom; community radio widespread
cultural_heritage.notes: AK-47 on flag (revolution); Portuguese colonial heritage; Makonde art; piri-piri cuisine; Marrabenta music; Island of Mozambique (Swahili+Portuguese heritage).

legal_system.legal_tradition: Civil law (Portuguese system) and customary law
legal_system.customary_law_role: Community courts (tribunais comunitários) apply customary law
legal_system.notes: FRELIMO dominance affects judiciary; community courts; Tribunal Administrativo (audit court); constitutional council.
